pages.title: Omnium Singularity
pages.text: A hoard of Omnium Ingots crushed into a single point, every concept compressed into one place. There is nothing left beyond it to compress it into. It is everything and nothing, and holding it feels final.
$(thing)Notebook$()$(br)I fed the Singularity Compactor Omnium Ingots until even they collapsed. The result was a point containing everything there is. I am not sure there is anything left to build.
